notes: Model: LDraw Official Model Repository file '42000-1 Grand Prix Racer.mpd', CC BY 2.0 (see its header). Not redistributed here; place it at samples/42000-1.mpd.

Ground truth: the curated functions of Kinebrick's data/sets/42000-1.json (erik-larsen/kinebrick, commit 516e176, CC BY-SA 4.0), which cite the set's three instruction books. Its part references (pN = the N-th part line of the model) were resolved to the box centres used here.
Phase 3 scores every mechanism without a phase; 'phase': 4 marks the function selector (driving ring + changeover catch), which belongs to gearbox modes.
Not expected: the shock absorbers' springs (they only push back under the model's weight; Kinebrick skips them too).
Parts are located by part number and world-box centre (LDU, LDraw axes: -Y is up). The front of the car is -Z.

mechanisms.title: Steering wheel -> column -> bevels under the nose -> 12T pinion -> 1x7 rack -> both front hubs
mechanisms.why: Kinebrick function 1 (rack-steering): the column runs forward under the nose through bevel gears to a gear on the steering rack, which pushes the track rods out to both front uprights.

checks.label: steering wheel turns both front hubs, rear hubs stay
column 20T double bevel drives the vertical 12T bevel
vertical 12T bevel drives the forward 20T double bevel
12T double bevel pinion drives the 1x7 rack
right front hub steers about its kingpin
left front hub steers about its kingpin

mechanisms.title: Rear wheels -> half-shafts -> differential -> 20T/12T -> V8 crankshaft -> pistons
mechanisms.why: Kinebrick function 2 (piston-engine: V8, differential): rolling the car turns the V8; turning one rear wheel with the other held turns the engine at half speed; the pistons slide in fixed cylinders.

checks.label: right rear wheel turns the crankshaft and the pistons
differential 28T bevel drives the 20T double bevel
20T double bevel drives the 12T on the crank axle (side by side)
right side gear meshes the differential's planet
left side gear meshes the differential's planet
piston slides in its cylinder

mechanisms.title: Front pushrod suspension: wishbone -> pushrod -> rocker -> shock absorber

checks.label: left front wishbone works the rocker and its shock
front shock rod slides in its cylinder

mechanisms.title: Rear pushrod suspension: wishbone -> pushrod -> rocker -> shock absorber

checks.label: left rear wishbone works the rocker and its shock
rear shock rod slides in its cylinder
right front rim turns on its hub axis
left front tyre turns on its hub axis

mechanisms.title: Function selector, one position: knob -> clutch gear -> rear linear actuator -> wing flap
mechanisms.why: Kinebrick function 3 (function-selector: 2 functions, linear-actuator: rear wing flap). Which lever position selects which function is not stated plainly.

checks.label: knob drives the rear wing actuator

mechanisms.title: Function selector, other position: knob -> clutch gear -> two linear actuators -> engine cover

checks.label: knob drives both engine cover actuators

mechanisms.title: The car drives: 4 wheels on 2 axles, front axle steered
mechanisms.why: Phase 5 (spec §5). Measured 2026-10-30: wheels 44771 at x = ±270, front axle z = -280 steered, rear z = 640; as posed the steering is straight (no slip).

checks.label: 4 wheels on 2 axles, 1 steered

mechanisms.title: Each rear suspension sweeps its wheel with no bump steer
mechanisms.why: Phase 5 (spec §5.6). Measured 2026-10-30: each rear arm swings about a pivot square to the car, so bump steer 0.000° and camber gain 0.0000°/LDU over 31.4 LDU of wheel travel; the 4254-in-4255 shock's stroke is -24..+18 LDU from its parts. maxDeg = measured + 0.5°.
